forecast.text: World Gold Council 2025 年度央行调查：约 95% 受访央行预计未来 12 个月全球官方黄金储备继续上升，约四成计划增持自身储备；动力为去美元化、地缘避险与利率环境。
forecast.textEn: World Gold Council 2025 annual central-bank survey: ~95% of respondents expect global official gold reserves to keep rising over the next 12 months and ~40% plan to add to their own reserves; drivers are de-dollarisation, geopolitical hedging and the rate environment.

drivers.name: 美债利率趋势
drivers.reason: 10Y 收益率 20 日 +29bp（走平）；准实际利率（10Y−CPI）≈1.59%：利率上行压制金价
drivers.reasonEn: 10Y yield +29bp over 20d (flat); real rate (10Y−CPI) ≈1.59%: rising yields pressure gold

drivers.name: 油价传导
drivers.reason: 布伦特 30 日 +25.9%（90 日 -4.4%）至 $103.87：短期方向主导——油价→CPI→利率压力
drivers.reasonEn: Brent +25.9% over 30d (-4.4% over 90d) to $103.87: the 30d direction dominates — oil→CPI→rates pressure

drivers.name: 政策定价
drivers.reason: Polymarket 加息概率 100.0%：紧缩定价利空
drivers.reasonEn: Polymarket hike odds 100.0%: hawkish pricing is bearish

drivers.name: 美元指数
drivers.reason: DXY 20 日 +1.24% 至 100.217：美元走强利空黄金
drivers.reasonEn: DXY +1.24% over 20d to 100.217: stronger dollar weighs on gold

drivers.name: 央行购金
drivers.reason: IMF 报告国近 12 个月净购金 +281 吨（2025-08~2026-07，买入仍在持续）+ WGC 调查 95% 央行料继续增持：结构性利多（未报告央行未计入）
drivers.reasonEn: IMF-reporting central banks net-bought +281 t over the last 12 months (2025-08–2026-07) and the WGC survey has 95% expecting more buying: structurally bullish (non-reporting banks excluded)

drivers.name: 美国债务负担
drivers.reason: 联邦债务/GDP 122.6%（2026-Q1，同比 +2.0pp），净利息支出年化 12 千亿美元：高债务+高利息挤压政策空间，财政主导与货币贬值担忧=黄金结构性利多
drivers.reasonEn: Federal debt at 122.6% of GDP (2026-Q1, +2.0pp y/y), net interest outlays $1247B annualised: high debt and interest costs squeeze policy room — fiscal-dominance and debasement concerns are structurally bullish for gold

drivers.name: 避险情绪
drivers.reason: VIX 20 日 -2.0% 至 14.8：避险需求

drivers.name: 通胀方向
drivers.reason: CPI 同比近两月 -0.1pp 至 3.4%（回落=降息依据），核心 PCE 季环比 +0.24pp 至 3.38%（回升=约束降息）：两口径方向分歧，计分按 CPI 6:PCE 4 折中；水平约束见信号面板「通胀约束」行
drivers.reasonEn: CPI YoY -0.1pp over 2m to 3.4%, core PCE q/q +0.24pp to 3.38% — the two gauges diverge; score = 60/40 blend of both directions (level constraint: see the 'Inflation constraint' row)

events.title: 利率决议
reasons: Polymarket 定价：加息 100.0% / 不变 0.0% / 降息 0.0%
核心 PCE 连续回升至 3.38%，通胀约束支持紧缩
但就业走弱（8 月 +16.2 万，7 月初值 −2.3 万）与 Q2 GDP 2.1% 使紧缩代价高
11/3 中期选举前政治上难以承受紧缩冲击 → AI 较市场更倾向按兵不动
reasonsEn: Core PCE back up to 3.38%: inflation constraint favors tightening
But weak jobs (Aug +162k; July initial −23k) and Q2 GDP 2.1% make tightening costly
Politically hard to tighten before the 11/3 midterms → AI leans hold vs the market

events.title: 9 月非农发布
reasons: ADP 私营 +3.8 万（官方-私营口径差约 +1 万政府就业）
挑战者裁员 +5.3 万：企业收缩信号
修正监测：7 月初值 −2.3 → 现值 +2.1（初值噪声大，区间放宽至 ±5 万）
reasonsEn: Revision tracker: July initial −23k → now +21k (noisy initial prints; range widened to ±50k)

events.title: Q2 GDP 终值 · 8 月 PCE
reasons: 初值口径下实际活动走弱信号（密歇根 51.7、ADP 偏弱）偏向微幅下修
核心 PCE 若继续回升（3.38%→?），12 月决议方向由它决定
reasonsEn: Weak real-activity signals vs initial print (U-Mich 51.7, soft ADP) tilt slightly downward
If core PCE keeps rising (3.38%→?), it decides the December meeting

events.title: 中期选举投票日
events.est: 选战白热化：政策人情窗口
reasons: 现任需要经济好、股市涨；选前财政/监管取向偏宽松
reasonsEn: Incumbent needs a good economy and rising stocks; fiscal/regulatory tilt eases pre-election

events.title: 年末决议
events.est: 若 9 月按兵不动，这是年内最后一次行动窗口
events.estEn: If September is a hold, this is the last window of the year
reasons: 取决于 9/11 CPI 与 9/30 PCE 路径：核心 PCE 回落则保留降息想象，回升则紧缩延续
reasonsEn: Depends on the 9/11 CPI and 9/30 PCE path: falling core PCE keeps cuts on the table; rising PCE extends tightening
